Method of Attack: Exploiting CVE-2018-8174 vulnerability in Internet Explorer's VBScript engine to deliver malware
Hijacking traffic of legitimate sites and redirecting IE users to web pages hosting RIG exploit kit
Smoke Loader acts as a malware dropper to download and install additional malware including coinminers
Impacted Systems: Users' computers infected by Smoke Loader and subsequent malware
Attack Vector: Web-based exploitation via Internet Explorer using CVE-2018-8174
Traffic hijacking and redirection to exploit kit landing pages
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept code on GitHub by Michael Gorelik
